item.title: Tokushima with Kids: Whirlpools, River Rafting & World Art Museum
item.description: Tokushima Prefecture sits on the eastern edge of Shikoku, Japan’s smallest main island, and it offers families something that is genuinely rare: a combination of natural spectacle, hands-on outdoor adventure, and world-class cultural institutions within manageable driving distances of each other. Children who have seen the Naruto whirlpools from a glass-bottomed boat, rafted a river through a marble gorge, and stood in front of a full-scale reproduction of Michelangelo’s Sistine Chapel ceiling tend not to forget their time in Tokushima.
